 
3-Episode Sri Lankan Romantic Drama
Genre: Romance / Drama / Inspirational
Setting: Modern-day Sri Lanka
Language: Sinhala
Total Episodes: 3
Approx. Duration: 1 minute per episode
Visual Style: Realistic Sri Lankan cinematic drama, natural lighting, emotionally grounded
performances, Colombo urban environment, warm romantic tones with realistic South Asian skin tones
and environments.
CAST / CHARACTER BIBLE
KASUN — Male Lead
Age: 27
Background: Comes from a financially struggling family. He lives simply and is determined to build a
successful business from nothing.
Appearance:
Sri Lankan male
Medium brown skin
Short black hair
Light stubble
Slim/athletic build
Friendly but serious eyes
Wardrobe:
Simple plain T-shirts or casual shirts
Dark jeans
Simple sandals or sneakers
Later, as his business grows, clean smart-casual clothingPersonality:
Hardworking
Humble
Ambitious
Romantic but not overly emotional
Proud of earning his success himself
Never wants to depend on Anudi's family money
Character Arc:
Poor young businessman → struggling entrepreneur → receives a major opportunity → refuses money
in exchange for his relationship → builds a successful restaurant → earns Anudi's father's respect.
ANUDI — Female Lead
Age: 25
Background: Comes from a comfortable middle-class Colombo family. She is educated, stylish and used
to a much more comfortable lifestyle than Kasun.
Appearance:
Sri Lankan woman
Medium/light brown skin
Long dark black hair
Elegant natural makeup
Attractive but realistic appearance
Wardrobe:
Modern casual dresses
Elegant blouse and trousers
Simple jewelry
Stylish handbag
Later, slightly more sophisticated outfits
Personality:
Kind
Independent-minded
Romantic
Family-oriented
Believes character matters more than wealthCharacter Arc:
Comfortable middle-class girl → meets Kasun → falls in love → challenges her father's expectations →
supports Kasun → chooses love and believes in his dream.
ANUDI'S FATHER
Age: 52–58
Appearance:
Sri Lankan businessman
Well-groomed
Short black/grey hair
Mature appearance
Wardrobe:
Polo shirts
Formal trousers
Smart casual shirts
Later, formal shirt and trousers
Personality:
Protective father
Practical
Financially successful
Initially judgmental about Kasun's financial situation
Believes financial stability is essential for marriage
Eventually respects Kasun's determination
Character Arc:
Rejects Kasun → tests Kasun → realizes Kasun's character → accepts him.
IMPORTANT CHARACTER CONTINUITY
Keep the following details consistent throughout all episodes:
Kasun always has the same facial appearance, hairstyle and general body type.
Anudi always has the same facial appearance, hairstyle and body type.
Anudi's father maintains the same appearance throughout.Kasun's three-wheeler remains the same vehicle.
Kasun's early food business remains visually small and humble.
The restaurant shown at the end should feel like the successful evolution of Kasun's original
business.
The story takes place in contemporary Sri Lanka.
Colombo should feel authentically Sri Lankan rather than looking like another country.
Avoid exaggerated Bollywood-style visuals.
Keep performances natural and realistic.
Maintain consistent wardrobe progression: Kasun starts poor/simple and gradually becomes
more polished as his business succeeds.
LOCATIONS
LOCATION 1 — Kasun's Food Three-Wheeler
A small Sri Lankan three-wheeler converted into a simple mobile food/tea business.
Details:
Colombo roadside
Small food containers
Tea flask
Short eats
Small handwritten menu
Plastic containers
Simple cash box
Foldable umbrella
This location represents Kasun's humble beginnings.

Busy but realistic Colombo street.
Details:
Cars
Tuk-tuks
Motorcycles
PedestriansSri Lankan shops
Tropical vegetation
Roadside businesses
Use natural Sri Lankan urban atmosphere.
LOCATION 3 — Anudi's Family Home
Comfortable middle-class Colombo home.
Details:
Modern living room
Sofa
Dining table
Decorative lighting
Family photographs
Clean, well-maintained interior
It should look financially comfortable but not like a billionaire mansion.
LOCATION 4 — Kasun's Small Workspace
A humble rented room or small food-preparation space.
Details:
Stainless-steel cooking equipment
Food containers
Notebooks
Calculator
Mobile phone
Business receipts
Small table
This location shows Kasun's entrepreneurial struggle.
LOCATION 5 — Successful Restaurant
The final location.
Details:Modern but approachable Sri Lankan restaurant
Warm interior lighting
Wooden tables
Sri Lankan-inspired design
Professional signage
Customers eating
Staff working
Large restaurant sign: “KASUN’S — Sri Lankan Food & Coffee”
The restaurant should clearly feel like the successful evolution of Kasun's original food business.

EPISODE 1 — THE FIRST MEETING
Approx. Duration: 1 minute
It was raining heavily in Colombo.
Kasun stood beside his small three-wheeler, selling homemade short eats and tea to office workers.
His clothes were simple, but his eyes were full of ambition.
“One day… I'll have my own restaurant,” he told himself.
Across the road, Anudi stepped out of a comfortable family car, dressed elegantly and holding an
umbrella.
She accidentally dropped her phone near Kasun's three-wheeler.
Kasun picked it up and ran after her.
Kasun:
“Miss! Your phone!”Anudi turned around.
Anudi:
“Oh… thank you.”
She looked at his little business.
Anudi:
“You made all this yourself?”
Kasun smiled.
Kasun:
“Started with Rs. 5,000. I'm trying to make it bigger.”
Anudi smiled back.
Suddenly, her phone rang.
It was her father.
Father:
“Anudi, where are you? Come home. We need to talk about your marriage.”
Her smile disappeared.
She looked at Kasun one more time.
Anudi:
“Maybe… I'll see you again.”
She walked away.
Kasun watched her leave.
He had no idea that this meeting was about to change his life.
END EPISODE 1
EPISODE 2 — THE DIFFERENCE
Approx. Duration: 1 minute
A few weeks passed.
Anudi started visiting Kasun's small business every evening.They talked.
They laughed.
And slowly, they fell in love.
One evening, Anudi's father saw them together.
That night, he confronted her at home.
Father:
“That boy? He has nothing!”
Anudi:
“He has a dream.”
Father:
“Dreams don't build a family. Money does.”
Meanwhile, Kasun was working day and night.
He had started supplying his food to three small shops.
One evening, Anudi visited him at his small workspace.
Anudi:
“Why are you working this hard?”
Kasun looked at her.
Kasun:
“Because I don't want your family to ever say I'm not good enough for you.”
Anudi held his hand.
Anudi:
“I don't care about your money.”
Kasun smiled.
Kasun:
“But I care.”
Suddenly, his phone rang.
It was a major supermarket chain.
They wanted to place a huge order.Kasun couldn't believe it.
Then the reality hit him.
He needed Rs. 2 million to expand.
And he had nowhere near that amount.
END EPISODE 2
EPISODE 3 — THE CHOICE
Approx. Duration: 1 minute
Kasun tried everything.
Loans.
Investors.
Friends.
Nobody believed in his small business.
Then Anudi's father came to meet him.
He placed a cheque on the table.
Father:
“Rs. 2 million.”
Kasun looked shocked.
Father:
“Take it. Build your business.”
Kasun smiled.
Kasun:
“Thank you, sir.”
But her father continued.
Father:
“There is one condition.”Kasun's smile disappeared.
Father:
“Leave my daughter.”
Kasun looked down at the cheque.
For a moment, he said nothing.
Then he slowly pushed the cheque back.
Kasun:
“Sir… I want your daughter.”
He stood up.
Kasun:
“But I don't want to buy my future with your money.”
He walked away.
MONTHS LATER
A large sign was unveiled:
KASUN'S — SRI LANKAN FOOD & COFFEE
The small business had become a successful restaurant.
Anudi stood beside Kasun.
Her father watched from a distance.
After a long silence, he walked toward them.
Father:
“I was wrong.”
Kasun looked at him.
Father:
“You didn't need my money to become successful.”
He held out his hand.
Father:
“You just needed someone to believe in you.”Kasun shook his hand.
Anudi smiled.
The three of them stood together beneath the restaurant sign.
FINAL TEXT ON SCREEN:
“Sometimes love doesn't need money.
It just needs someone who believes in your dream.”
THE END
